name: 2027 Kurt J Nellis Memorial Tournament
venueName: Shaler Area High School - Gym A
weighin: No weight changes at Sunday weigh-ins. Flat weight (No Allowance) Shaler Area High School Wrestling Room - 381 Wible Run Rd, 15209 (Weigh-in in singlet) • Saturday, January 9h , 6p-8p (All Divisions) • Sunday, January 10th , 7a-8a (Novice) | 11a-12p (Open & Girls)
about:
Date: Sunday, January 10th, 2027
Location: Shaler Area High School Gym A - 381 Wible Run Rd, Pittsburgh, PA 15209
Details: Tournament will be run on FloArena

Time: NOVICE: 9am | OPEN & GIRLS DIVISION: 1pm

Awards: OPEN & GIRLS: 1st & 2nd Place Trophies, 3rd & 4th Medals – Championship T-Shirts
NOVICE: 1st– 4th Place Trophies

Rules: PIAA modified rules. Double elimination. NO TRUE SECOND. Bout times are: 1 – 1 – 1 minute
periods, PIAA overtime. (1 minute OT/30 seconds ride-out). Weight divisions with Five or less wrestlers
will wrestle round robin. Weight divisions may be combined, and brackets may be split at tournament
director’s discretion. Referee and Tournament Directors decisions are final. Blind seeding

Entry Fee: $40.00 per wrestler - Online Only NO REFUNDS. Double entries permitted / No double entry in
same age group.

Weigh-In: No weight changes at Sunday weigh-ins. Flat weight (No Allowance)
Shaler Area High School Wrestling Room - 381 Wible Run Rd, 15209 (Weigh-in in singlet)
• Saturday, January 9th - 6p-8p (All Divisions)
• Sunday, January 10th - 7a-8a (Novice) | 11a-12p (Open & Girls)

Novice Division
6 & under - 40, 45, 50, 55, 60, 65, 70, 85
8 & under - 45, 50, 55, 60, 65, 70, 80, 90, 100
10 & under - 55, 60, 65, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90, 110, 130 
12 & under – 65, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 100, 105, 110, 120, 130, 140, 150

Open Division
8 & under - 45, 50, 55, 60, 65, 70, 80, 90, 100, 110
10 & under - 55, 60, 65, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 100, 110, 120, 130, 140, 150
12 & under - 65, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 100, 105, 115, 125, 135, 145, 160, 180

Girls Division
Madison Weight Classes will be utilized. Where not possible, you will have the option to
enter the mixed brackets with appropriate age, weight, and experience.

Concessions: Available all day!
Admissions: Adults $7.00 (including coaches) | Students $3.00 (5 and under free)
Eligibility: Age as of DECEMBER 31st, 2026. Proof will be required if age is challenged. Challenger must
provide, as well.
